data.name: Harmeet
data.gender_notes: Harmeet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Har means 'God' and Meet means 'nectar'. This name is derived from the Hindu mythology where the Gods and Demons churned the ocean to obtain Amrit, the elixir of immortality. Harmeet refers to the nectar obtained from this process. The name Harmeet carries the meaning “God's nectar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harmeet usually hope their child will grow to embody god's nectar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Harmeet belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's nectar.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harmeet total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
